title: Respect reduced motion
summary: GSAP matchMedia can choose different motion based on a media query.
introduction: GSAP matchMedia can choose different motion based on a media query. Your task: Turn on reduced motion and compare the result.

Explain the example for respect reduced motion

blocks.text: GSAP matchMedia can choose different motion based on a media query. A reduced-motion preference should get a calmer version.
Use a browser project with GSAP 3 installed. Each example creates its own small box. Run one example at a time with a module build tool. GSAP is not loaded by this site's plain runner.

blocks.title: Respect reduced motion

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `prefers-reduced-motion` checks a user preference. The reduced version should still show all important content.
`textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.
`createElement` makes a new element in memory. Append it to the document when you want it to appear.

blocks.text: People who allow motion get a short entrance. Those requesting less motion see the normal box directly.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not hide the box in CSS and rely on a skipped animation to reveal it.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Turn on reduced motion and compare the result.
